related.title: GoogLeNet Inception：瓶頸與多尺度分支
related.titleEn: GoogLeNet Inception: bottlenecks and multiscale branches
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩種計算圖、權重預算與逐層激活診斷表。；6912與27648計數正確，且報告明確區分相同感受野與不同非線性映射。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver both graphs, a weight budget and layerwise activation diagnostics.; Counts6912 and27648 must match, and the report distinguishes equal receptive fields from different nonlinear mappings.
related.difference: 畫64→16→32通道支路，並與另一路32通道在相同H,W串成64通道。；兩份MAC表吻合，分支空間尺寸一致；若瓶頸品質下降超教學2百分點則拒絕。
related.differenceEn: Draw64→16→32 channels and concatenate with another32-channel branch at the same H,W to form64 channels.; MAC sheets agree and branch spatial sizes match; reject if the teaching quality loss exceeds2 percentage points.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在相同Cin=Cout=C、不計偏置時，三層3×3參數為27C²；單層7×7為49C²，感受野皆7但函數不等價。；教學C=16，步幅1、等尺寸補零；比較三層3×3與一層7×7。；堆疊P=3×9×16²=6912；C改32時P=27648。單層7×7在C16時為12544。
1×1降維再3×3的每位置MAC=CinB+9BCout；分支串接沿通道軸。；教學Cin=64、瓶頸B=16、Cout=32，省略偏置與激活。；MAC=64×16+9×16×32=5632；B=8時2816。直接3×3為18432。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For equal width C and no biases, three3×3 layers use27C² parameters versus49C² for one7×7; both span7 pixels but implement different functions.; Teaching C=16, stride one and same-size padding; compare three3×3 layers with one7×7.; Stacked P=3×9×16²=6912; at C=32 it is27648. A7×7 layer at C16 uses12544.

A1×1 reduction followed by3×3 costs CinB+9BCout MACs per position; branches concatenate along channels.; Teaching Cin=64, bottleneck B=16 and Cout=32; omit biases and activations.; MAC=64×16+9×16×32=5632; B=8 gives2816. Direct3×3 costs18432.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: DeepLab：空洞卷積與取樣盲點
related.titleEn: DeepLab: atrous convolution and sampling gaps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩種計算圖、權重預算與逐層激活診斷表。；6912與27648計數正確，且報告明確區分相同感受野與不同非線性映射。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver both graphs, a weight budget and layerwise activation diagnostics.; Counts6912 and27648 must match, and the report distinguishes equal receptive fields from different nonlinear mappings.
related.difference: 畫5×5及9×9方格，只標實際9個取樣點，旁列未取樣位置。；跨度5與9可重建，且報告明列9點取樣與未取樣區。
related.differenceEn: Draw5×5 and9×9 grids marking only the nine sampled points and the gaps.; Reconstruct spans5 and9 and explicitly identify sampled points and gaps.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 在相同Cin=Cout=C、不計偏置時，三層3×3參數為27C²；單層7×7為49C²，感受野皆7但函數不等價。；教學C=16，步幅1、等尺寸補零；比較三層3×3與一層7×7。；堆疊P=3×9×16²=6912；C改32時P=27648。單層7×7在C16時為12544。
有效核跨度keff=1+(k−1)d；跨度增加不代表每個中間位置被取樣。；教學k3、d2，改為d4；權重仍9個每輸入輸出通道對。；keff=1+2×2=5 px；d4時9 px。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For equal width C and no biases, three3×3 layers use27C² parameters versus49C² for one7×7; both span7 pixels but implement different functions.; Teaching C=16, stride one and same-size padding; compare three3×3 layers with one7×7.; Stacked P=3×9×16²=6912; at C=32 it is27648. A7×7 layer at C16 uses12544.
Effective span keff=1+(k−1)d; wider span does not sample every intermediate position.; Teaching k3,d2 then d4; still nine weights per channel pair.; keff=1+2×2=5 px; d4 gives9 px.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
